title: Raise default_statistics_target 300->500 for skewed GetUserTweets selectivity
configuration_cause: default_statistics_target=300 leaves histogram/MCV resolution coarse for the heavily skewed user_id predicate driving GetUserTweets, which consumes 87.6% of client terminal capacity; finer statistics can tighten the index path and reduce per-call pages.
mechanism: GetUserTweets dominates terminal capacity (0.876 fraction, p50 138us, p95 200us). Its predicate on skewed user_id is planned from column statistics; at target 300 the histogram/MCV sample is coarse relative to the skew. Raising to the safe high bound 500 increases resolution 1.67x, letting the planner pick a tighter index path and fewer heap pages per call, lowering per-transaction service time and freeing terminal capacity for more completed transactions. This is a distinct amplitude from the refuted 100->300 step (r006) and the untested 300->500 parked edge.
query_effect: Finer user_id selectivity estimates should keep GetUserTweets on a stable Index Scan with fewer estimated-vs-actual row mismatches, reducing pages touched per call.
expected_tps_effect: Modest increase in successful_transaction_tps as GetUserTweets service time falls and terminal capacity is freed.
expected_latency_effect: Small decrease in GetUserTweets p50/p95; other transaction classes roughly unchanged.

predictions.rationale: Finer histogram/MCV resolution for skewed user_id tightens the index path, lowering median service time.
Better selectivity estimates reduce occasional over-fetch of heap pages, trimming the p95 tail.
Lower GetUserTweets service time frees terminal capacity, raising completed transaction throughput.

alternatives.statement: If the GetUserTweets plan is already optimal at target 300, raising to 500 changes no plan and latency/TPS stay flat.
If higher statistics target only adds ANALYZE cost without plan change, TPS may dip slightly while latency is unchanged.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Incumbent already accepted the coarsest SIRead locking win; the remaining dominant cost is GetUserTweets terminal occupancy. Finer statistics at the safe high bound is the untested amplitude on the planner axis and can reduce per-call pages without touching the proven lock settings.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Raise from incumbent 300 to the safe high bound 500 (allowed [50,500]); 1.67x histogram/MCV resolution for skewed user_id, distinct from the refuted r006 100->300 step.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: column statistics resolution for skewed predicate selectivity

nodes.label: Finer user_id selectivity estimates tighten GetUserTweets index path

cross_domain_requirements: ANALYZE must run after the statistics target change for the new resolution to take effect on tweets.user_id.
